name: Do I need to make repairs before selling my condo for cash?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to make repairs before selling my condo for cash?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically, you do not need to make repairs when selling a condo for cash, as cash buyers often purchase properties in their 'as-is' condition. This saves you time, money, and effort. However, disclosing any known issues is crucial for a transparent transaction. Kelby Contreras can advise on how the 'as-is' condition might impact offers in your specific market, like Collier County.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, cash buyers usually purchase condos 'as-is,' eliminating the need for pre-sale repairs.
